## Summary

The refresh operation should preserve existing fingerprints so that adding files does not erase evidence of edits to tracked files.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh manifest fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for both operations. Tests were read, not run.

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints during refresh — When you refresh `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` after editing the tracked file, verification incorrectly succeeds. The unconditional assignment replaces its original fingerprint; the refresh test exercises only an unchanged tracked file. — Refreshing after adding files can erase the integrity baseline and prevent users from detecting hand-edited tracked content.
